contract: Construct a length-prefixed NAL reader for each sample and provide windows of 1, 7 or 4,096 bytes. FFmpeg receives the same complete samples through the AVC or HEVC MP4-to-Annex-B filter initialized with empty configuration arrays and the same length width. Script packet metadata and side data are outside this comparison.

Remove the start code or length field and compare all units in source order. Fold kind 1 with sample and unit index, sample-relative payload offset, unit type, AVC ref idc and zero or HEVC layer id and temporal id plus one, and length and bytes, including the original header. The reference obtains offsets from the returned order and lengths. Fold kind 7 with sample index and unit count or kind 8 with sample index on refusal.
Loading and script parsing are outside the operation. Reader setup, window feeding, reference Annex B conversion and splitting, ordered folding and teardown are inside.

The opaque source bytes contain an unescaped start code, ambiguous when split after Annex B conversion
